title: Course Manifest
description: Extended metadata for a course in the LibV2 repository

chunker_version.description: Phase 7a Subtask 8: version of the chunker that produced the archived chunks. MIGRATION DRIFT (post-Phase-8 review): this field's semantics shifted from 'Python-package release version of ed4all-chunker' (resolved via importlib.metadata.version('ed4all-chunker'), e.g. '0.1.0') to 'chunker-schema-contract version' (resolved via Trainforge.chunker.CHUNKER_SCHEMA_VERSION, e.g. 'v4') after the ed4all-chunker workspace package was folded back into Trainforge/chunker/. The contract version is bumped only when the emit shape or semantics change, decoupled from any Python-package release cadence. Optional in Phase 7a (Wave 7); promoted to required by the Phase 7c validator wiring once both the DART chunkset (Phase 7b) and IMSCC chunkset (Phase 7c) emitters are settled. Pattern alternation accepts BOTH the new ^v\d+$ schema-version form ('v4') AND the legacy ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:[+-]...)?$ semver form ('0.1.0', '0.1.0+missing', '1.0.0-rc1') so any pre-migration manifest on disk continues to validate.

extraction_contract.description: Chunk-TEXT extraction-contract version — ORTHOGONAL to chunker_version (the emit SHAPE). Versions the semantics of WHAT TEXT lands in a chunk's `text` field: the always-on Trainforge/parsers/html_content_parser.py::HTMLTextExtractor contract (screen-reader-scaffolding suppression + structural delimiters). chunker_version deliberately stays 'v4' across extraction-text changes, so this finer integer marker is what a provenance consumer (e.g. the tier-2 citation-anchoring floor gate in Trainforge/tests/test_citation_anchor_contract.py) reads to tell whether the archived corpus was produced under the CURRENT extraction-text contract. Sourced from Trainforge.chunker.EXTRACTION_TEXT_CONTRACT_VERSION at archive time (bumped whenever chunk-text extraction semantics change again). Mirrors the extraction_contract field on the chunkset sidecar manifests. OPTIONAL: legacy manifests that predate the marker validate without it and are treated as legacy (pre-marker) by the provenance gate.

concept_graph_sha256.description: Phase 6 Subtask 17: SHA-256 of concept_graph_semantic.json produced by the concept_extraction workflow phase. Promoted to required by Phase 7c Subtask 17 alongside dart_chunks_sha256 + imscc_chunks_sha256 — the LibV2ManifestValidator now fail-closes when any of the three chunkset/graph hashes is absent.

dart_chunks_sha256.description: Phase 7b/7c: SHA-256 of LibV2/courses/<slug>/dart_chunks/chunks.jsonl produced by the chunking workflow phase (Phase 7b ST 11). Required by Phase 7c Subtask 17; ties the archived DART chunkset to the course manifest. Validator: lib.validators.libv2_manifest.LibV2ManifestValidator._check_dart_chunks_sha256.

imscc_chunks_sha256.description: Phase 7c: SHA-256 of LibV2/courses/<slug>/imscc_chunks/chunks.jsonl produced by the imscc_chunking workflow phase (Phase 7c ST 16). Required by Phase 7c Subtask 17; ties the archived IMSCC chunkset to the course manifest. Validator: lib.validators.libv2_manifest.LibV2ManifestValidator._check_imscc_chunks_sha256.

source_documents_sha256_index.description: GPT Feedback v2 (May 12 / item 3): set of SHA-256 hashes for every upstream source document (PDFs, IMSCC archive) that contributed to this archived course. Populated from source_artifacts.pdf[].checksum and source_artifacts.imscc.checksum at archive time. Optional: legacy manifests (pre-May-2026) lack this field and continue to validate. Provides a single auditor-friendly join key from manifest to upstream bytes without walking the source_artifacts subtree.

graph_build_hash.description: GPT Feedback v2 (May 12 / item 3): mirror of concept_graph_semantic.json::graph_build_hash, copied onto the manifest at archive time so an auditor reading the manifest alone sees graph-input lineage without opening the graph artifact. Optional: legacy manifests lack this field and continue to validate.

rulepack_version.description: GPT Feedback v2 (May 12 / item 3): mirror of concept_graph_semantic.json::rulepack_version, aggregate version of the rulepack that produced the archived graph. Optional: legacy manifests lack this field and continue to validate. See Trainforge.rag.inference_rules.RULEPACK_VERSION for the producer.

course_package_version.description: GPT Feedback v2 (May 12 / item 3): mirror of concept_graph_semantic.json::course_package_version, Courseforge run signature / IMSCC archive version that produced this course. Emitted as null today (Courseforge does not yet produce a stable signature); schema admits a future string value without a migration. Optional.

import_timestamp.description: When the course was imported to LibV2

sourceforge_version.description: Sourceforge version that produced this output

eval_profile.description: Wave 132c: explicit Trainforge eval-harness profile. When set, Trainforge.eval.slm_eval_harness._resolve_default_profile uses this value directly instead of substring-sniffing classification fields. Add new enum values when authoring new Trainforge/eval/configs/<name>.yaml profiles.

tags.description: Wave 133f: HuggingFace model-card tags appended to the default ['education','qlora','peft','trainforge',<slug>] list when an adapter for this course publishes. Replaces the substring sniff in Trainforge.eval.hf_model_index.write_hf_readme — manifest-driven so non-RDF/SHACL courses can declare their own discovery tags without code changes.

prerequisites.description: Course slugs that should be completed before this one

successor_courses.description: Courses that build on this one

difficulty_distribution_descriptor.description: Deterministic descriptor over the 3 ordered difficulty bands (honest IRT scaffold, gated by TRAINFORGE_IRT_DIFFICULTY_SCAFFOLD). Mirrors corpus_stats.difficulty_distribution_descriptor; emitted by lib/assessment/irt_difficulty.py::describe_difficulty_distribution. Optional -> legacy manifests still validate.

attestation.description: I5 human-review attestation: a named reviewer's sign-off that this course's objectives / content / full artifacts were checked by a person. Optional -> legacy manifests validate without it. Stamped via the GUI PATCH /api/courses/{id}/attestation (gui.services.course_service.save_attestation); reviewed_at is server-stamped (UTC ISO-8601) when the caller omits it.

reviewed_by.description: Name / identity of the person who reviewed the course.

reviewed_at.description: When the review was attested (UTC ISO-8601). Server-stamped when omitted by the caller.

scope.description: What the reviewer attests to: the learning objectives only, the generated content only, or the full course.

library_format_version.description: OP4 library-format version — the on-disk LibV2 course-layout contract this manifest was written against (distinct from ``libv2_version``, the manifest-document schema version, and ``chunker_version``, the chunk-emit contract). Starts at '1.0'. Optional -> legacy manifests that predate the field validate without it (fsck/validators treat a missing field as the pre-1.0 baseline: serve read-only + warn, never silent). Bumped only when the course-directory layout / manifest contract changes in a way that requires a migration; the migration framework has shipped as the `libv2 migrate` subcommand (LibV2/tools/libv2/migrate.py — dry-run default, --apply, legacy->1.0 baseline step). Contract: docs/operations/library-versioning.md.

license.description: B3 optional license declaration for the archived source corpus. Optional -> legacy manifests validate without it (absent = byte-identical manifest). Threaded from the ``--license-note`` run flag. When present, the archival step also writes a human-readable NOTICE file into the course dir.

spdx_or_name.description: SPDX identifier (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', 'CC0-1.0') or a human license name.

note.description: Optional free-text license note / redistribution terms.

attribution.description: B3 optional source-attribution declaration for the archived corpus. Optional -> legacy manifests validate without it (absent = byte-identical manifest). Threaded from the ``--attribution`` run flag. Mirrored into the human-readable NOTICE file at archive time.

source_title.description: Title of the upstream source work (e.g. the textbook title).

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the upstream source work, when one exists.

statement.description: The required attribution statement to reproduce (e.g. 'Access for free at openstax.org').
